summary: PREFLIGHT-1 grilled + read-only Codex critique (stage 1) applied. Part A confirmed complete against existing durable-access policy (no policy change, no new decision, preserve projected-browser branch). Part B reworked to a single-event application-owned notification port wired from Control+IPC, dispatched async (no double event, no layering violation, creation not slowed). Part C tests the compiled prompt. Story marked user_facing; one decision, not two.
gaps: Whether a request_access kind:tool grant for a canonical facade tool is accepted as a durable rule end-to-end (button eligibility + persistent grant application + readiness), or whether Part A also needs a durable-access-policy acceptance change or the button fails on tap.
Whether calling notifyJobSetupRequired from the application/jobs layer crosses the runtime(jobs) architecture boundary enforced by check_architecture, and the correct seam if so.
Whether the operating-guidance line for Part C is actually applied to the job-creating agent and not dead (like renderDefaultCapabilityRules).
contradictions: Plan originally proposed prime auto-discovery, which contradicts the neutral-across-both-lanes constraint (prime is Anthropic-only; DeepAgents has no record-without-execute mode and would execute tools for real).
Plan originally proposed swapping recordJobSetupRequired for notifyJobSetupRequired, which would drop the passive JOB_SETUP_REQUIRED event that read-models consume.

Plan originally proposed a new attemptsToAccessRequirements mapper, duplicating the dead JobPrimingService and the existing normalizeAccessRequirements pipeline (violating single-canonical-shape 0112/0113).
resolutions: Prime auto-discovery rejected and recorded as a rejected alternative; upfront declaration is prompt-based (agent populates access_requirements at creation), which is lane-neutral and reuses the existing readiness pipeline. Runtime button/pause remains the fallback.

Part B changed to ADD notifyJobSetupRequired alongside recordJobSetupRequired (keep the passive event); the existing notified_fingerprint dedup prevents a duplicate card versus the later runtime pause.

No new mapper: reuse normalizeAccessRequirements -> evaluateJobReadiness and the existing scheduler_upsert_job access_requirements argument; dead JobPrimingService noted as separate cleanup, not a third path.

Codex critique (PREFLIGHT-1-1) resolved the parked items: Part A durable acceptance already exists (bug reconciliation); Part B uses an application-owned notification port + single event + async dispatch (fixes double-event + illegal application->jobs import + creation latency) and adds ipc-scheduler-create-handlers.ts to scope; Part C asserts the compiled prompt; decomposition marked user_facing; one decision.
open_items: Full cross-lane prime parity (DeepAgents record-without-execute) is out of scope; revisit only if neutral auto-discovery is later required.
Confirm the new decision number against origin/main at record time to avoid collision.
